key_insight: The paper proposes a Multi-layer Fusing Transformer to better combine image and Vietnamese text features for visual question answering.
clinical_relevance: This work may support future Vietnamese-language AI tools for image-based assistance in healthcare, education, and patient-facing communication.
method: Uses a multi-layer fusing transformer architecture
Applies cross-attention to merge visual and textual features
Aggregates information from low-level to high-level representations
evidence_signal: The model was evaluated on the ViVQA dataset and reported promising results against competitive baselines, including ablation studies.
watch_item: Performance is reported only from the abstract, so real-world robustness and generalization in clinical settings remain unverified.
paper_title: Fusing Visual and Textual Representations via Multi-layer Fusing Transformers for Vietnamese Visual Question Answering
